description_en: Invokes the UpdateVirtualPhysicalConnection operation to modify the information about a shared Express Connect circuit
description_zh: 调用UpdateVirtualPhysicalConnection接口修改共享专线信息
name: UpdateVirtualPhysicalConnection

parameters.help_en:
The VLAN ID of the shared Express Connect circuit. Valid values: 0 to 2999.

A value of 0 specifies that the physical vSwitch port of the Virtual Border Router (VBR), which acts as a vRouter, does not use the VLAN mode, but uses the Layer 3 routing interface mode. In the Layer 3 routing interface mode, each Express Connect circuit corresponds to one VBR.
A value of 1 to 2999 specifies that the physical vSwitch port of the VBR uses a VLAN-based Layer 3 subinterface. In the Layer 3 subinterface mode, each VLAN ID corresponds to one VBR. In this case, the Express Connect circuit of the VBR can be used to connect VPCs that belong to different Alibaba Cloud accounts. Layer 2 network isolation is implemented for VBRs in different VLANs, and they cannot communicate with each other
parameters.help_zh:
共享专线的VLAN ID。取值范围：0~2999。

VLAN ID为0时，表示边界路由器VBR（Virtual Border Router）的物理交换机端口不使用VLAN模式，而使用三层路由接口模式。三层路由接口模式下每一条物理专线对应一个VBR。
VLAN ID为1~2999时，表示VBR的物理交换机端口使用基于VLAN的三层子接口。三层子接口模式下每个VLAN ID对应一个VBR。此时，该VBR的物理专线可以连接多个账号下的VPC。不同VLAN下的VBR二层网络隔离，无法互通
parameters.name: vlan_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the shared Express Connect circuit
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request may be different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to only perform a dry run for the request. Valid values:

true: The system performs a dry run without modifying the VLAN ID of the shared Express Connect circuit. The system checks whether the required parameters are specified, the request format, and the instance status. If the request fails the dry run, the corresponding error is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the corresponding request ID is returned.
false (default): The system sends a normal request. After the request passes the dry run, the VLAN ID of the shared Express Connect circuit is modified
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值范围：

true：发送检查请求，不会修改共享专线的VLAN ID。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、实例状态。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回对应请求ID。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接修改共享专线的VLAN ID
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The expected bandwidth of the shared Express Connect circuit. The bandwidth takes effect only after the payment is completed.

Valid values: 50M, 100M, 200M, 300M, 400M, 500M, 1G, 2G, 5G, 8G, and 10G.

<props="china">
The bandwidth values of 2G, 5G, 8G, and 10G are not available by default. To use these values, contact your account manager.</props>

<props="intl">
The bandwidth values of 2G, 5G, 8G, and 10G are not available by default. To use these values, contact your account manager.</props>

Unit: M indicates Mbps, and G indicates Gbps
parameters.help_zh:
共享专线的预计带宽值。完成支付后，带宽值才能生效。

取值：50M、100M、200M、300M、400M、500M、1G、2G、5G、8G、10G。

<props="china">
2G、5G、8G、10G的带宽值默认不开放，如需使用，请向您的客户经理申请。</props>

<props="intl">
2G、5G、8G、10G的带宽值默认不开放，如需使用，请向您的客户经理申请。</props>

单位：M表示Mbps，G表示Gbps
parameters.name: expect_spec

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the shared Express Connect circuit.

You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
共享专线所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

Success.description_en:
Specifies whether the VLAN ID of the shared Express Connect circuit is successfully modified.

true: The VLAN ID was modified.
false: The VLAN ID was not modified
Success.description_zh:
是否已成功修改共享专线的VLAN ID。

true：已成功修改。
